**Do not carry the Orion XS map onto an Orion-Tr Smart.** They are different products with different record types (0x04 vs 0x0F), different field sets, and no shared document. The names are three characters apart and one Quebec retailer already lists both under headings that blur them.

Output voltage is signed (−327.68..327.66 V, NA 0x7FFF) while input voltage is unsigned (NA 0xFFFF). Two different sentinel widths in adjacent 16-bit fields; treating either as a value yields 655.34 V or 327.67 V, both plausible-looking on a 48 V system.
